markets.title: Griffin Jax: 12+ Outs Recorded?
markets.rules_primary: If Griffin Jax has 12+ outs recorded in the Milwaukee vs Tampa Bay professional baseball game originally scheduled for Oct 27, 2026 at 8:00 PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Griffin Jax is scratched or is not a starting pitcher, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Griffin Jax is not a starting pitcher but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, relief appearances will not count towards this market.
If Griffin Jax is a starting pitcher and records at least one pitch the market will settle based on outs recorded.
